"A sound society in harmony with nature."

TRCC Vision Statement
Who We Are

Planting Trees.
Restoring Life.

TRCC is dedicated to restoring the environment through tree planting and community action. Since 2001, we have worked with rural communities to grow trees, restore degraded land, and build sustainable livelihoods through nature-based solutions.

Vision

A sound society living in harmony with nature, where communities and ecosystems thrive together sustainably.

Mission

To create awareness and build the capacity of rural communities by promoting sustainable agriculture, environmental conservation, healthy living, and the preservation of indigenous knowledge.

Objectives

We promote natural resource conservation, educate communities on environmental and socio-economic sustainability, and support improved livelihoods through practices like organic farming, mixed cropping, and livestock production.
